    Week plans

    Five dinners, one shop

    Five easy weeknight dinners from the book, picked so they share ingredients (a bunch of spring onions or a tray of chicken thighs goes across several nights) while every night is different. Add a plan and the shopping list combines it all.

    Cooking for
    Prices

    Leave out

    Allergies, dietary needs or just not a fan: plans and picks skip any dinner with these.

      Matched on ingredient names in the book, so always check the labels on jars and packets.

      Build your own

      Pick up to four dinners you're craving. The rest of the week is filled in with easy dinners that share their shopping.

        No ready-made plan fits everything you're leaving out. Try building your own above.

        Basics

        Supermarket shortcuts for the nights you don't want to cook from scratch. They turn up in the plans above too.

        • Butter ChickenA jar of sauce, a tray of chicken thighs and a pack of naan: a takeaway night from the supermarket.
        • Old El Paso TacosTaco night from the kit: everyone builds their own, and the table ends up covered in lettuce.
        • Ravioli and SauceFresh ravioli and a tub of sauce from the fridge section: dinner in the time it takes the water to boil.
